what.text: This page follows refugees from Iraq living in Iran, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 12175 Iraqi refugees in Iran, 4.5% of all refugees from Iraq.
Today Germany hosts the most Iraqi refugees, followed by the United Kingdom, Türkiye and France.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over Kurdistan territory in Iraq from 1974 to 1992, with the KDP, PUK and KDP-QM, and an interstate armed conflict between Iraq and Kuwait in 1990 and 1991.
It also records armed conflict over the government of Iraq from 1991 to 1996 and in every year from 2004 to 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1979 at 30000 refugees.
The figure was at its highest, 1250057, at the end of 1992, and the main years of displacement in the data are 1990 to 1993.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Iran.
These are year-end totals for Iran only, reported to UNHCR.
